summary: Narragansett Bancorp, Inc., a Maryland corporation, filed an 8-K reporting completion of its subscription offering tied to the proposed two-tier mutual-to-stock holding company reorganization of BayCoast Bank and Narragansett Financial Corporation. The offering was oversubscribed by Bank depositors of record as of May 31, 2025, so no community or syndicated community offering is expected. Closing of the offering and reorganization remains subject to customary final regulatory approvals and conditions. Final offering results and anticipated closing date will be announced after all approvals are received. Watchers await regulatory clearance timing.
